answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns stays locked for, say, 30 epochs and is clawed back if later audits show its attestations came from a colluding cluster. A farm of a thousand sparrow-light accounts must keep all of them funded, active and undetected for the full window, so capital sits idle while risk compounds. Honest agents grow slowly like a cedar; fakes that rush in like fish to a reef find their payouts frozen before they can cash out.
